# Troubleshooting {#sec-troubleshooting}

| Message or symptom | Likely cause | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| `... is larger than maximum allowed: skipped` | `prefetch`'s 20 GB default limit | `--max-size u` |
| `disk-limit exceeded` / `No space left on device` | Not enough space for temp + output | Point `--temp` at a disk with space; free space; check `df -h` ([fasterq-dump](fasterq-dump.qmd#disk-space)) |
| `Disk quota exceeded` in your home | Downloads or cache going to `~/ncbi` | `vdb-config --prefetch-to-cwd`, `cd` to a folder with space, delete `~/ncbi/public/sra` |
| Hangs or `timeout exhausted while reading file within network system module` | Network trouble or NCBI busy | Retry later; prefer `prefetch` (resumes) over streaming |
| `item not found` / `failed to resolve accession` | Not a run accession, or not public yet (embargoed) | Use `SRR`/`ERR`/`DRR`; check the run page |
| `fasterq-dump: command not found` | Toolkit not loaded / not on `PATH` | `conda activate sra`, `module load ...`, or `export PATH=...` ([Setup](setup.qmd)) |
| Only one FASTQ for a paired run | Technical reads skipped, or submitted interleaved/concatenated | [Special cases](special-cases.qmd) |
| `_1` and `_2` have different read counts | A file is truncated | `gzip -t`; reconvert that run |
| Quality line is all `?` | SRA Lite data | Fine for counting; for qualities, prefer Normalized in `vdb-config -i` |
| `vdb-validate` reports errors | Corrupt download | Delete the run folder and `prefetch` again |
| Some runs failed, others finished | Network drops; unavoidable now and then | `scripts/find_missing.sh` → `failed.txt` → resubmit ([Retrying](at-scale.qmd#retrying)) |
| `_1` and `_2` differ in read count after `fastq-dump --split-files` | Unpaired spots went into `_1` only | Reconvert with `--split-3` ([Three converters](fasterq-dump.qmd#three-converters)) |
| `vdb-config -i` shows garbage or won't open over ssh | Full-screen mode not supported by the terminal | `vdb-config --interactive-mode textual` |
| Leftover `fasterq.tmp.*` folders | A conversion was killed | Delete them |
| Array tasks say `fasterq-dump not found` | No conda env active and module name differs | `conda activate sra` before `sbatch`, or `--export=ALL,SRA_MODULE=<name>` ([Downloading many runs](at-scale.qmd#route-c-an-array-job-on-a-slurm-cluster)) |
